name: onchain
description: Official Robinhood Chain (4663) tools through the Splice capability broker: native balances, transactions with receipts, and token reports (RPC, Blockscout, CoinGecko, GoPlus on the host). No keys in the package.

tools.name: balance
tools.description: Native ETH balance of an address on Robinhood Chain, pinned to the block it was read at (provenance.blockNumber).

output.description: Host capability result: LIVE/CACHED with data { wei, formatted, symbol } and provenance, or UNAVAILABLE/ERROR

tools.name: transaction
tools.description: A transaction and its receipt on Robinhood Chain (status success, reverted or pending).

output.description: Host capability result: LIVE/CACHED with data (transaction + receipt) and provenance, or UNAVAILABLE/ERROR

tools.name: token
tools.description: Report on a Robinhood Chain token: metadata, total supply, holders, price, DEX pools and security — one section per source, each with its own status and provenance.

output.description: Host composite { kind: "composite", sections: { metadata, totalSupply, holders, price, pools, security } } or an ERROR result for invalid input
